body: Here's the test org I created - https://dev.to/atestorganization ... happy to delete whenever.

Well, I think the culprit is here https://github.com/thepracticaldev/dev.to/blob/39618f66a2167e88e65527b68d0fd996f0869c0a/app/controllers/organizations_controller.rb#L73

According to issue [28060 on the rails project](https://github.com/rails/rails/issues/28060), strip_tags since v1.0.3 encodes special html characters (&, <, > ...) by default. To restore its previous behaviour, we can use Loofa directly:

```
Loofah.fragment(value).text(encode_special_chars: false)
``` 

 **This solution, however, does *NOT* fix existing organizations.** 

Another way to fix this would be to mark the fields in the view ``app/views/users/_profile_header.html.erb`` as ``raw`` or ``html_safe``. This solution DOES fix existing organizations, but it won't scale well: we would have to mark every existing field that accepts & (and any new ones we might add in the future) as ``raw`` before displaying it.

I'd love to make a pull request to fix this issue later today, but I want to make sure these solutions don't introduce a sneaky security bug.

## What type of PR is this? (check all applicable)

- [x] Bug Fix

## Description

According to [issue 28060 on the rails project](https://github.com/rails/rails/issues/28060), ``strip_tags`` since v1.0.3 encodes special html characters (&, <, > ...) by default. To restore its previous behaviour, I'm using Loofah directly, which is what ``strip_tags`` uses behind the scene. 

This solution does **NOT** fix existing organizations, they will need to be updated replacing ``&`` with ``&``. I chose this solution over fixing how we show the ``&`` in the view, because:

1. [Storing HTML encoded characters in the database might be a problem if we decide to display the data in a non-HTML format](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/4598802/should-we-html-encode-special-characters-before-storing-them-in-the-database/20700136)
2. This bug was present in all text fields that accepted & (not only the name of the organization)
